newsitem.title: USA: Scherer, Merck in softgel development pact.
newsitem.headline: Scherer, Merck in softgel development pact.

text.p: R. P. Scherer Corp said Friday it agreed to be the exclusive developer of softgel products for Merck & Co Inc, the largest U.S. drugmaker.
Scherer said it will co-develop with Merck softgel formulations of drug compounds designated by Merck, and will be compensated by Merck for development activities.
Softgel products commercialized following development would be supplied exclusively by Scherer, the company said.
"In addition, Scherer would receive royalties on sales of products which utilize patentable intellectual property which may result from the development programs," it said.
